notes: Fourth edition held 10 to 16 May 2026 in Desa Kintamani, Bangli; the festival moves village each year (Denpasar 2023, Buleleng 2024, Guwang 2025). Non-profit run, free entry, publishes a sponsorship email (tangisaf@gmail.com) and openly seeks brand partners. Small scale (4,000 IG followers); backers are culture ministry, Dutch cultural bodies and small brands. Bio's '5 years' conflicts with a 2023 founding; first-edition question (Bali Sun) left open.
